traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Frankeniaceae: leaves opposite; leaves simple; leaves evergreen; blades linear; stipules usually absent, sometimes present; plants usually hermaphrodite, rarely polygamous; ovary superior; stems woody or herbaceous; flowers solitary or in cymes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit capsule; stamens (4-) 6 (-24); carpels (2-) 3 (-4). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
